encode_audio_waveform: encode audio waveform into discrete codes using EncodecModel.encode with specified bandwidth
decode_audio_codes: decode discrete audio codes back to waveform using EncodecModel.decode with scales and padding mask
encode_decode_audio: encode and decode audio through EncodecModel forward pass for full codec pipeline
quantize_audio_embeddings: quantize audio embeddings using EncodecResidualVectorQuantizer with configurable number of quantizers
overlap_add_frames: overlap-add decoded audio frames with linear fade-in/fade-out using EncodecModel._linear_overlap_add
